tools.name: cantorfi_vaults
tools.description: Live state of every CantorFi isolated lending vault: token, supplied, borrowed, available liquidity, utilization, borrow and supply APR, borrow limit, liquidation threshold and liquidation bonus.

tools.name: cantorfi_vault
tools.description: Live state of one CantorFi vault, chosen by token symbol (USDC, WETH), vault id or vault address.

tools.name: cantorfi_contracts
tools.description: Network, chain id, deployment block and addresses of the CantorFi contracts: protocol registry, vault factory, reader, price oracle and every vault with its token, receipt token and staking contract.

tools.name: cantorfi_liquidation_bot
tools.description: How to run the open-source CantorFi liquidation bot: read-only without a key, or liquidating with the user's own wallet. Returns the repository and the commands filled with the network values.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search CantorFi vaults and guides (isolated lending, liquidations, prediction market settlement, B20 tokens, ERC-4626); returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full record of one CantorFi vault or full text of one guide, by id (from search).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
